en: you
zh: 你
ja: あなた
local: you
ja_pron: anata
native: you

en: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural
zh: 兩千多年前，古代中國學者觀察了我們自然界中變化的模式
ja: 2000年以上前、古代の中国の学者たちは自然界の変化する様子を観察しました
local: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural
ja_pron: 2000 nen ijō mae, kodai no Chūgoku no gakusha-tachi wa shizen-kai no henka suru yōsu o kansatsu shimashita
native: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural

en: world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.
zh: 世界、氣候、季節的更替和天文現象。
ja: 世界、気候、季節の移り変わり、そして天文学を観察しました。
local: world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.
ja_pron: sekai, kikō, kisetsu no utsurikawari, soshite tenmongaku o kansatsu shimashita
native: world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.

en: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-year-old parts, creating
zh: 學者們測量並將太陽的年度運動分成24個部分，創造了
ja: 学者たちは太陽の年間の動きを測定し、24の部分に分けて作り出しました
local: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-year-old parts, creating
ja_pron: gakusha-tachi wa taiyō no nenkan no ugoki o sokutei shi, 24 no bubun ni wakete tsukuridashimashita
native: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-year-old parts, creating

en: the 24-so-returns, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.
zh: 二十四節氣，這些被用來管理古代中國的農業。
ja: 二十四節気は古代中国の農業を管理するために使われました。
local: the 24-so-returns, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.
ja_pron: nijūshi sekki wa kodai Chūgoku no nōgyō o kanri suru tame ni tsukaware mashita
native: the 24-so-returns, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.

en: According to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds
zh: 直到今天，這項發明仍指導著數億中國人的生活和傳統。
ja: 今日に至るまで、この発明は何億もの中国人の生活と伝統を導いています。
local: According to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds
ja_pron: kyō ni itaru made, kono hatsumei wa nan-oku mo no Chūgokujin no seikatsu to dentō o michibiite imasu
native: According to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds

en: of millions of Chinese people.
zh: 數以億計的中國人。
ja: 何億もの中国人の生活と伝統です。
local: of millions of Chinese people.
ja_pron: nan-oku mo no Chūgokujin no seikatsu to dentō desu
native: of millions of Chinese people.

en: On or around December 27th of each year, Chinese people get ready for the winter solstice
zh: 每年12月27日左右，中國人準備迎接冬至
ja: 毎年12月27日頃、中国の人々は冬至の準備をします。
local: On or around December 27th of each year, Chinese people get ready for the winter solstice
ja_pron: maitoshi 12 gatsu 27 nichi goro, Chūgoku no hitobito wa tōji no junbi o shimasu
native: On or around December 27th of each year, Chinese people get ready for the winter solstice

en: solitaire.
zh: 節氣。
ja: 節気です。
local: solitaire.
ja_pron: sekki desu
native: solitaire.

en: This is a festival to mark the shortest day of new year.
zh: 這是一個標誌新年最短白晝的節日。
ja: これは新年の最も昼が短い日を示す祭りです。
local: This is a festival to mark the shortest day of new year.
ja_pron: kore wa shinnen no mottomo hiru ga mijikai hi o shimesu matsuri desu
native: This is a festival to mark the shortest day of new year.

en: There's always been a significant date in the Chinese calendar.
zh: 這一直是中國曆法中的重要日期。
ja: これは中国の暦の中で常に重要な日付です。
local: There's always been a significant date in the Chinese calendar.
ja_pron: kore wa Chūgoku no koyomi no naka de tsuneni jūyō na hizuke desu
native: There's always been a significant date in the Chinese calendar.

en: Emperors would have held a ceremony, and students might have huddled together and worship
zh: 皇帝會舉行儀式，學生們可能會聚集一起祈禱
ja: 皇帝は儀式を行い、学生たちは集まって祈りを捧げたかもしれません。
local: Emperors would have held a ceremony, and students might have huddled together and worship
ja_pron: kōtei wa gishiki o okonai, gakusei-tachi wa atsumatte inori o sasageta kamoshiremasen
native: Emperors would have held a ceremony, and students might have huddled together and worship

en: in the future, feasting on dumplings in the master.
zh: 未來，大家會在一起吃餃子慶祝。
ja: 将来、人々は一緒に餃子を食べて祝ったでしょう。
local: in the future, feasting on dumplings in the master.
ja_pron: shōrai, hitobito wa issho ni gyōza o tabete iwatta deshō
native: in the future, feasting on dumplings in the master.

en: Winter solstice is the 22nd of the ancient 24-so-returns, but it was the very first to be created.
zh: 冬至是古代二十四節氣中的第二十二個，但它是最早被創造的。
ja: 冬至は古代の二十四節気の22番目ですが、最初に作られたものです。
local: Winter solstice is the 22nd of the ancient 24-so-returns, but it was the very first to be created.
ja_pron: tōji wa kodai no nijūshi sekki no 22-banme desu ga, saisho ni tsukurareta mono desu
native: Winter solstice is the 22nd of the ancient 24-so-returns, but it was the very first to be created.

en: Documents show that at least 2500 years ago, the ancient Chinese concluded that in the
zh: 文件顯示，至少2500年前，古代中國人得出結論
ja: 文献によると、少なくとも2500年前に古代中国人は結論を出しました
local: Documents show that at least 2500 years ago, the ancient Chinese concluded that in the
ja_pron: bunken ni yoru to, sukunakutomo 2500 nen mae ni kodai Chūgokujin wa ketsuron o dashimashita
native: Documents show that at least 2500 years ago, the ancient Chinese concluded that in the

en: northern hemisphere, this was the shortest day with the longest hours of darkness.
zh: 北半球，這是白晝最短、黑夜最長的一天。
ja: 北半球では、昼が最も短く、夜が最も長い日でした。
local: northern hemisphere, this was the shortest day with the longest hours of darkness.
ja_pron: hokuhankyū de wa, hiru ga mottomo mijikaku, yoru ga mottomo nagai hi deshita
native: northern hemisphere, this was the shortest day with the longest hours of darkness.

en: This made it a very special note of time, they thought, and the beginning of the next
zh: 他們認為這是一個非常特別的時間標記，也是下一個週期的開始
ja: 彼らはこれを非常に特別な時間の印と考え、次の周期の始まりとしました。
local: This made it a very special note of time, they thought, and the beginning of the next
ja_pron: karera wa kore o hijō ni tokubetsu na jikan no shirushi to kangae, tsugi no shūki no hajimari to shimashita
native: This made it a very special note of time, they thought, and the beginning of the next

en: cycle saw ancient Chinese emperors offering prayers on winter solitaire.
zh: 古代中國皇帝會在冬至節氣時祈禱。
ja: 古代の中国の皇帝は冬至の節気に祈りを捧げました。
local: cycle saw ancient Chinese emperors offering prayers on winter solitaire.
ja_pron: kodai no Chūgoku no kōtei wa tōji no sekki ni inori o sasagemashita
native: cycle saw ancient Chinese emperors offering prayers on winter solitaire.

en: Cian in China's Shanxi province has a long history, more than 3,000 years.
zh: 中國山西省的祁安有著超過3000年的悠久歷史。
ja: 中国の山西省にある祁安は3000年以上の長い歴史があります。
local: Cian in China's Shanxi province has a long history, more than 3,000 years.
ja_pron: Chūgoku no Sanshō-shō ni aru Kian wa 3000 nen ijō no nagai rekishi ga arimasu
native: Cian in China's Shanxi province has a long history, more than 3,000 years.

en: To believe, this is where the winter solstice solitaire first turned into a Chinese festival,
zh: 據信，這裡是冬至節氣首次成為中國節日的地方，
ja: 信じられているのは、ここが冬至の節気が初めて中国の祭りになった場所だということです。
local: To believe, this is where the winter solstice solitaire first turned into a Chinese festival,
ja_pron: shinjirarete iru no wa, koko ga tōji no sekki ga hajimete Chūgoku no matsuri ni natta basho da to iu koto desu
native: To believe, this is where the winter solstice solitaire first turned into a Chinese festival,

en: and where it first became an official solitaire, one of the 20th century.
zh: 也是它首次成為官方節氣的地方，20世紀之一。
ja: そしてそれが初めて公式の節気となった場所でもあります。20世紀の一つです。
local: and where it first became an official solitaire, one of the 20th century.
ja_pron: soshite sore ga hajimete kōshiki no sekki to natta basho demo arimasu. 20 seiki no hitotsu desu
native: and where it first became an official solitaire, one of the 20th century.

en: If we ask ourselves, who knows the most about Chinese traditional culture in Cian, it must
zh: 如果我們問自己，誰最了解祁安的中國傳統文化，那一定是
ja: もし自分に問うなら、祁安で中国の伝統文化を最も知っているのは誰か、それはきっと
local: If we ask ourselves, who knows the most about Chinese traditional culture in Cian, it must
ja_pron: moshi jibun ni tou nara, Kian de Chūgoku no dentō bunka o mottomo shitte iru no wa dare ka, sore wa kitto
native: If we ask ourselves, who knows the most about Chinese traditional culture in Cian, it must

en: be one journey.
zh: 一段旅程。
ja: 一つの旅でしょう。
local: be one journey.
ja_pron: hitotsu no tabi deshō
native: be one journey.

en: Working at the Cian in Tangible Cultural Protection Centre, he is a member of this
zh: 他在祁安有形文化保護中心工作，是這個
ja: 彼は祁安の有形文化保護センターで働いており、この
local: Working at the Cian in Tangible Cultural Protection Centre, he is a member of this
ja_pron: kare wa Kian no yūkei bunka hogo sentā de hataraite ori, kono
native: Working at the Cian in Tangible Cultural Protection Centre, he is a member of this

en: active rescue and protection group, also the first line of defence for Chinese culture.
zh: 積極救援和保護團隊的成員，也是中國文化的第一道防線。
ja: 積極的な救助と保護グループのメンバーであり、中国文化の最前線の防御者でもあります。
local: active rescue and protection group, also the first line of defence for Chinese culture.
ja_pron: sekkyokuteki na kyūjo to hogo gurūpu no menbā de ari, Chūgoku bunka no saizensen no bōgyosha demo arimasu
native: active rescue and protection group, also the first line of defence for Chinese culture.

en: From 4 to 8 to 24, China's 24 solar terms originated 3,000 years ago in the Joel Dynasty.
zh: 從4到8再到24，中國的二十四節氣起源於3000年前的周朝。
ja: 4から8、そして24へ、中国の二十四節気は3000年前の周王朝に起源を持ちます。
local: From 4 to 8 to 24, China's 24 solar terms originated 3,000 years ago in the Joel Dynasty.
ja_pron: 4 kara 8, soshite 24 e, Chūgoku no nijūshi sekki wa 3000 nen mae no Shū ōchō ni kigen o mochimasu
native: From 4 to 8 to 24, China's 24 solar terms originated 3,000 years ago in the Joel Dynasty.

en: The winter solstice solitaire happens around the same time as the Chinese New Year, and
zh: 冬至節氣大約與中國新年同時發生，並且
ja: 冬至の節気は中国の旧正月とほぼ同じ時期に起こり、そして
local: The winter solstice solitaire happens around the same time as the Chinese New Year, and
ja_pron: tōji no sekki wa Chūgoku no kyūshōgatsu to hobo onaji jiki ni okori, soshite
native: The winter solstice solitaire happens around the same time as the Chinese New Year, and

en: is as equally as important.
zh: 同樣重要。
ja: 同じくらい重要です。
local: is as equally as important.
ja_pron: onaji kurai jūyō desu
native: is as equally as important.

en: Every year at the winter solstice solitaire, Cian's drum tower quarter will be alive
zh: 每年冬至節氣，祁安的鼓樓區都會熱鬧非凡
ja: 毎年冬至の節気には、祁安の鼓楼地区が賑わいます。
local: Every year at the winter solstice solitaire, Cian's drum tower quarter will be alive
ja_pron: maitoshi tōji no sekki ni wa, Kian no korō chiku ga nigiwaimasu
native: Every year at the winter solstice solitaire, Cian's drum tower quarter will be alive

en: with ritual noises and prayers hosting the liveliest of festivals.
zh: 充滿儀式的聲音和祈禱，舉辦最熱鬧的節日。
ja: 儀式の音や祈りで溢れ、最も賑やかな祭りが開催されます。
local: with ritual noises and prayers hosting the liveliest of festivals.
ja_pron: gishiki no oto ya inori de afure, mottomo nigiyaka na matsuri ga kaisai saremasu
native: with ritual noises and prayers hosting the liveliest of festivals.

en: People trade in various household goods in preparation for the New Year.
zh: 人們交易各種家庭用品，為新年做準備。
ja: 人々は新年の準備のために様々な家庭用品を売買します。
local: People trade in various household goods in preparation for the New Year.
ja_pron: hitobito wa shinnen no junbi no tame ni samazama na katei yōhin o baibai shimasu
native: People trade in various household goods in preparation for the New Year.

en: The customs of Cian and winter solstice solitaire are a part of Wongjoon's research interests.
zh: 祁安和冬至節氣的習俗是王俊研究興趣的一部分。
ja: 祁安と冬至の節気の習慣は、ウォンジュンの研究関心の一部です。
local: The customs of Cian and winter solstice solitaire are a part of Wongjoon's research interests.
ja_pron: Kian to tōji no sekki no shūkan wa, Wonjun no kenkyū kanshin no ichibu desu
native: The customs of Cian and winter solstice solitaire are a part of Wongjoon's research interests.

en: In class, he meets renowned pastry chef, Ma Shunli.
zh: 在課堂上，他遇見了著名的糕點師馬順利。
ja: 授業で彼は有名な菓子職人、マー・シュンリーに出会います。
local: In class, he meets renowned pastry chef, Ma Shunli.
ja_pron: jugyō de kare wa yūmei na kashi shokunin, Mā Shunrī ni deaimasu
native: In class, he meets renowned pastry chef, Ma Shunli.

en: She has inherited this most Chinese form of intangible heritage dumpling.
zh: 她繼承了這種最具中國特色的非物質文化遺產餃子。
ja: 彼女はこの最も中国的な無形文化遺産の餃子を受け継いでいます。
local: She has inherited this most Chinese form of intangible heritage dumpling.
ja_pron: kanojo wa kono mottomo Chūgokuteki na mukē bunka isan no gyōza o uketsuide imasu
native: She has inherited this most Chinese form of intangible heritage dumpling.

en: Starting at age 16, she has now made all, as we say in Chinese, wrapped dumplings for 33 years.
zh: 從16歲開始，她已經包餃子33年了，正如我們用中文說的那樣。
ja: 16歳から始めて、彼女は今や33年間、中国語で言うところの包んだ餃子を作っています。
local: Starting at age 16, she has now made all, as we say in Chinese, wrapped dumplings for 33 years.
ja_pron: 16 sai kara hajimete, kanojo wa imaya 33 nenkan, Chūgokugo de iu tokoro no tsutsunda gyōza o tsukutte imasu
native: Starting at age 16, she has now made all, as we say in Chinese, wrapped dumplings for 33 years.

en: Of all the customs, Chinese people carry out at winter solstice solitaire, dumpling
zh: 在所有冬至節氣的習俗中，中國人最重視吃餃子，
ja: 冬至の節気に中国人が行うすべての習慣の中で、餃子を食べることが最も重要です。
local: Of all the customs, Chinese people carry out at winter solstice solitaire, dumpling
ja_pron: tōji no sekki ni Chūgokujin ga okonau subete no shūkan no naka de, gyōza o taberu koto ga mottomo jūyō desu
native: Of all the customs, Chinese people carry out at winter solstice solitaire, dumpling

en: eating is number one.
zh: 吃餃子是第一位。
ja: 餃子を食べることが一番です。
local: eating is number one.
ja_pron: gyōza o taberu koto ga ichiban desu
native: eating is number one.

en: About 1,800 years ago, their lived a healer called John John Tippen.
zh: 大約1800年前，有一位名叫張仲景的醫生。
ja: 約1800年前、張仲景という治療者がいました。
local: About 1,800 years ago, their lived a healer called John John Tippen.
ja_pron: yaku 1800 nen mae, Chō Chūkei to iu chiryo-sha ga imashita
native: About 1,800 years ago, their lived a healer called John John Tippen.

en: He went back to his hometown on winter solstice, in one year, and found many villages with
zh: 他在某年冬至回到故鄉，發現許多村莊
ja: 彼はある年の冬至に故郷に戻り、多くの村が
local: He went back to his hometown on winter solstice, in one year, and found many villages with
ja_pron: kare wa aru toshi no tōji ni kokyō ni modori, ōku no mura ga
native: He went back to his hometown on winter solstice, in one year, and found many villages with

en: frosted layers.
zh: 覆蓋著霜層。
ja: 霜に覆われているのを見つけました。
local: frosted layers.
ja_pron: shimo ni ōwarete iru no o mitsukemashita
native: frosted layers.

en: John John Tippen ordered his apprentice to cook up some mutton broth laced with chili
zh: 張仲景命令他的徒弟煮一些加了辣椒的羊肉湯
ja: 張仲景は弟子に唐辛子を加えた羊肉のスープを作るよう命じました。
local: John John Tippen ordered his apprentice to cook up some mutton broth laced with chili
ja_pron: Chō Chūkei wa deshi ni tōgarashi o kuwaeta yōniku no sūpu o tsukuru yō meijimashita
native: John John Tippen ordered his apprentice to cook up some mutton broth laced with chili

en: peppers and herbs.
zh: 辣椒和草藥。
ja: 唐辛子とハーブを加えました。
local: peppers and herbs.
ja_pron: tōgarashi to hābu o kuwaemashita
native: peppers and herbs.

en: Wrapped it in dough pockets shaped like ears and passed them out to everyone in hot soup.
zh: 將其包成像耳朵形狀的麵團，並用熱湯分發給每個人。
ja: それを耳の形をした生地で包み、熱いスープと一緒に皆に配りました。
local: Wrapped it in dough pockets shaped like ears and passed them out to everyone in hot soup.
ja_pron: sore o mimi no katachi o shita kiji de tsutsumi, atsui sūpu to issho ni mina ni kubarimashita
native: Wrapped it in dough pockets shaped like ears and passed them out to everyone in hot soup.

en: A bowl of hot dumplings in the belly and the frosting villages weigh.
zh: 一碗熱騰騰的餃子讓村莊的寒冷消散。
ja: 熱い餃子の一杯が村の寒さを和らげました。
local: A bowl of hot dumplings in the belly and the frosting villages weigh.
ja_pron: atsui gyōza no ippai ga mura no samusa o yawaragemashita
native: A bowl of hot dumplings in the belly and the frosting villages weigh.

en: Since then, every winter solstice solitaire people imitate this by making ear-like edifice.
zh: 從那時起，每年冬至節氣人們都模仿這個，做出像耳朵一樣的餃子。
ja: それ以来、毎年冬至の節気に人々はこれを真似て耳のような形の餃子を作っています。
local: Since then, every winter solstice solitaire people imitate this by making ear-like edifice.
ja_pron: sore irai, maitoshi tōji no sekki ni hitobito wa kore o manete mimi no yō na katachi no gyōza o tsukutte imasu
native: Since then, every winter solstice solitaire people imitate this by making ear-like edifice.

en: A long time in the making, this tale is the universal backstory of the dumpling eating
zh: 這個故事經過長時間的流傳，是吃餃子習俗的普遍起源。
ja: 長い時間をかけて作られたこの物語は、餃子を食べる習慣の普遍的な背景です。
local: A long time in the making, this tale is the universal backstory of the dumpling eating
ja_pron: nagai jikan o kakete tsukurareta kono monogatari wa, gyōza o taberu shūkan no fuhenteki na haikei desu
native: A long time in the making, this tale is the universal backstory of the dumpling eating

en: at winter solstice solitaire.
zh: 在冬至節氣。
ja: 冬至の節気に。
local: at winter solstice solitaire.
ja_pron: tōji no sekki ni
native: at winter solstice solitaire.

en: Dafachan is the longest-standing restaurant to serve such a dumpling banquet.
zh: 大發餐館是提供這種餃子宴席歷史最悠久的餐廳。
ja: 大発餐館はこのような餃子の宴を提供する最も歴史のあるレストランです。
local: Dafachan is the longest-standing restaurant to serve such a dumpling banquet.
ja_pron: Daihatsu sankan wa kono yō na gyōza no utage o teikyō suru mottomo rekishi no aru resutoran desu
native: Dafachan is the longest-standing restaurant to serve such a dumpling banquet.

en: Nearly 100 years have passed since they began making the superb dumplings.
zh: 自從他們開始製作這些美味餃子已經快100年了。
ja: 彼らが素晴らしい餃子を作り始めてからほぼ100年が経ちました。
local: Nearly 100 years have passed since they began making the superb dumplings.
ja_pron: karera ga subarashii gyōza o tsukuri hajimete kara hobo 100 nen ga tachimashita
native: Nearly 100 years have passed since they began making the superb dumplings.

en: It is now considered one of the legends of ancient sea air.
zh: 現在被認為是古代海岸的傳說之一。
ja: 今では古代の海岸の伝説の一つと考えられています。
local: It is now considered one of the legends of ancient sea air.
ja_pron: ima de wa kodai no kaigan no densetsu no hitotsu to kangaerarete imasu
native: It is now considered one of the legends of ancient sea air.
